title: The Pet Sitter Report: I'm So Sorry
trend: TikTok 'I'm So Sorry' reveal (a story built up slide by slide, then the real outcome revealed with 'I'm so sorry'; SocialPilot TikTok formats list, Oct 27 - Nov 10 2026, US) — teen pet sitter Tyler gives Marla his week report as she gets home, every story ending 'I'm so sorry': the fern now lives in the tub, the dog chose the Thanksgiving turkey for dinner, the cat befriended the mail carrier through the doorbell speaker; twist: Marla watched every night on the dog camera with her whole family and popcorn, Tyler is now famous in the family and invited to Thanksgiving — and she is the one who is sorry
youtube_title: The pet sitter's week report... I'm so sorry 🐶
description:
Marla is finally home. Tyler watched the dog, the cat and the plants all week, and he has a report. Every part of it ends the same way.

#cartoon #animation #funny #petsitter #shorts
tiktok_caption: the pet sitter's week report... I'm so sorry 🐶 #cartoon #animation #funny #petsitter

lines.text: Welcome home, Missus Marla. Before you look around, I have a report.
Oh no. Why are you holding a clipboard?
Monday. You said water the plants. So I watered the plants.
A lot. Like, a lot a lot.
How much is a lot a lot?
The fern lives in the bathtub now. It has a little boat.
I'm so sorry.
Tyler, it's a fern. It's fine. Ferns love water.
The fern is happier than all of us.
Okay. Wednesday. You said let Pancake pick his dinner.
I meant chicken or beef.
He walked to the freezer. He looked me in the eye.
I chose the big one.
The big one? The Thanksgiving turkey?
He ate the whole turkey. I made gravy. It felt rude not to.
I'm so sorry.
I am not sorry. I am full. Since Wednesday.
That turkey was for twelve people!
I have a big heart. And a big middle.
Is it my turn? I would like a turn.
Sir Fluff. You have never said one word to me.
You never asked about my day, Marla.
Friday. The cat learned the doorbell speaker.
I press the button with my face. People listen.
He made friends with the mail carrier. Her name is Denise.
Denise brings me treats. I give her life advice.
What kind of life advice?
Mostly to quit. She quit. She opened a bakery.
So you won't get mail for a while. I'm so sorry.
Who delivers the mail now?
Me. On Tuesdays. I am very slow.
And Saturday was the big one. Are you sitting down?
The neighbors think you're a very rude British lady.
I spoke on the doorbell all week. As you.
What did I say?
You told Missus Kowalski her leaf pile was amateur.
It was amateur. I have been in it.
I'm so, so sorry. Here is your key. I'll go live in the woods.
Tyler. Stop. Sit down. I have to tell you something.
See that little camera on the shelf? The dog camera?
The one that looks like an egg with a feeling?
I watched it. Every night. With my whole family.
My sister made popcorn. Uncle Ray brought a chair from the garage.
You saw the boat? In the tub?
We named it. We cheered for the gravy. Grandma cried.
I knew it. I winked at the egg every night.
You're famous in my family now. They want you at Thanksgiving.
But there is no turkey.
There is gravy. Where the turkey was.
And they want a show. Every night until Christmas.
So I watch the pets again tomorrow?
No. I watch you. Watching the pets. On the egg.
I'm so sorry, Tyler. You live in a show now.
Can the fern be in it?
The fern has an agent.
Who do you think the agent is?
